newsitem.title: USA: U.S. chain store sales up 0.6 pct - BTM/Schroders.
newsitem.headline: U.S. chain store sales up 0.6 pct - BTM/Schroders.

text.p: U.S. chain store sales rose 0.6 percent in the week ended May 3 from the prior week, according to the seasonally adjusted BTM/Schroders weekly chain store sales index.
The year-over-year percentage change of the adjusted index advanced 3.1 percent during the last reporting week. The month-to-date index fell 1.3 percent from the prior month.
"Sales were generally on-to-above plan for most retailers for the week, yet the sales index remained below its 16-week rolling trend for the fourth week," the report said.
The report, which is normally embargoed for 0900 EDT/1300 GMT, was again released early by other news agencies.
